superseded_specification.supersession_reason: Corrects C15 narrative typographical defect (which claimed 41 DEV / 39 HOLDOUT while manifests had 40/40), remedies C16 in-place mutation, and introduces cryptographic manifest hash binding under GOV-RULE-085.

scientific_invariance_declaration: Zero bytes of Level-1 GRD imagery, segmentation masks, cluster identities, or partition assignments have changed. The physical dataset is 100% byte-identical to C14 initial assembly.

preprocessing_specification.normalization: Standardization strictly using TRAIN split valid pixels (DN > 0)

governance_and_firewall_rules.clustering: GOV-RULE-077 (Mission datatake clustering to prevent along-track pseudo-replication)
governance_and_firewall_rules.partitioning: GOV-RULE-075 (Pre-slice parent clustering before spatial slicing)
governance_and_firewall_rules.qc_standard: GOV-RULE-079 (Four distinct QC layers: Technical, Provenance, Semantic, Independence)
governance_and_firewall_rules.holdout_firewall: HOLDOUT is strictly quarantined from development, training, tuning, and threshold selection.
governance_and_firewall_rules.freeze_immutability: GOV-RULE-085 (Cryptographically locked freeze specification; in-place mutations prohibited)
governance_and_firewall_rules.runtime_assertion: GOV-RULE-086 (Runtime assertion of exact sample IDs and partition counts against frozen manifest)

known_scientific_limitations.single_archive_grounding: 100% of samples are derived from the Li IW archive; this provides independent acquisitions but not multi-source benchmark diversity (GOV-RULE-084).

sparse_classes.HM: 14 parent clusters (8 TRAIN, 3 DEV, 3 HOLDOUT), 1,847 total valid pixels across full dataset (117 px on DEV). Inadequate for unweighted macro generalization claims.
sparse_classes.OF: 7 parent clusters (4 TRAIN, 1 DEV, 2 HOLDOUT), 33,706 valid pixels (1,709 px on DEV).
sparse_classes.RF: 13 parent clusters (7 TRAIN, 2 DEV, 4 HOLDOUT), 9,550 px on DEV.
sparse_classes.AF: 10 parent clusters (5 TRAIN, 3 DEV, 2 HOLDOUT), 39,385 px on DEV.

known_scientific_limitations.georeferencing: Relative pixel grid alignment is verified; absolute geocoding in GeoTIFF headers is an engineering placeholder transform (GOV-RULE-083).
